title: e-Tender for Empanelment of Agencies for Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning (SITC) of External Glow/Non-lit Sign Boards
scope_summary: Empanelment of agencies for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of external glow/non-lit sign boards for branches, ATMs, and offices across India, including the replacement of flex, vinyl, and related accessories of existing sign boards. The tender requires BIS certified LED module systems.
